title: Replace Placeholder with Low-Poly Dung Beetle
objective: Replace the humanoid placeholder with a distinctive low-poly dung beetle burglar built entirely from Godot-native primitive meshes while preserving TB-R01 movement, camera, interaction, collision reliability, and all existing gameplay.
acceptance: the Body visual root contains a separate abdomen, thorax, head, visible burglar mask, three left legs, three right legs, and two antennae
the character is constructed only from deterministic repository-native low-poly primitive meshes with no external model or animation dependency
head, mask, antennae, and anatomy establish -Z as the obvious visual front matching the TB-R01 controller
the entire beetle rotates together through the stable Body visual root
visual height is approximately 0.9–1.3 world units and the collision remains one practical capsule compatible with current corridors
camera framing remains practical for the shorter beetle and existing mouse/camera behavior is preserved
TB-001, TB-002, TB-003, and TB-R01 regressions pass, two rendered screenshots are produced, and the Linux exported runtime loads every level
no gameplay mechanic, animation, audio, external asset, level-data change, or unrelated feature is introduced
